_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); beverage and convenient-food signals

pit_profile.why: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2019, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 22% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2019 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one

theme_watch.reason: Live: PepsiCo's own FY2019 10-K says 'Disruption in the retail landscape, including rapid growth in the e-commerce channel and hard discounters, can adversely affect our business, financial condition or results of operations.' At the same time it sells through e-commerce itself: 'Our products are also available and sold directly to consumers on a growing number of company-owned and third-party e-commerce websites and mobile commerce applications.'. The stock trades at 20.0x FY20E — near its own median. Re-file as DISRUPTION_EXPOSED (ECOMMERCE) only if dated evidence shows the market pricing the shift away from physical retail into PepsiCo's own sales specifically.

classification.quality_note: PepsiCo: 'We are a leading global food and beverage company with a complementary portfolio of brands, including Frito-Lay, Gatorade, Pepsi-Cola, Quaker and Tropicana'; 'Our beverage, food and snack products are in highly competitive categories and markets', 'In 2019, we and The Coca-Cola Company represented approximately 22% and 20%, respectively, of the U.S. liquid refreshment beverage category by estimated retail sales in measured channels', and 'However, The Coca-Cola Company has significant carbonated soft drink (CSD) share advantage in many markets outside the United States' (its own FY2019 10-K): a competition and consumer-taste risk, not an obsolescence one. durable franchise (obsolescence risk 2/5); price fair; Ratio B 1.60x; +11% to EPP floor; model-vs-market gap +0.14; conservative 2yr +13%.

BEAR.desc: EPS -40.8%/yr (worst year FY10-FY19, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS +7.2%/yr (Q4 rev ex-FX + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr median

BULL.desc: EPS +7.2%/yr (FY10-FY19 CAGR); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +41.9%/yr (best 2-yr run FY10-FY19); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: PEP (retrospective, 2020-03-20) ◐ WATCHLIST — Ratio B 1.60x (74.0% downside to Bear $27 / +46.3% upside to Bull $152) | Adj composite 2.56 vs market 2.42: gap +0.14 [FAIRLY VALUED] | +11% above the EPP floor $94 (18x FY20E $5.20) | Conservative 2-yr case: +12.9% total (+6.4%/yr) | At 20.0x FY20E the 15% hurdle price $137 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; servings not reported for Q4 2019, forward revenues +5.7% (Q4 2019 net revenue ex-currency); e-commerce is live and company-acknowledged; no dated evidence ties the multiple to it.
